steps.name: Environment setup and safe persistence
steps.description: Validate Node/Yarn/NPM and key helper utilities, determine canonical npm global bin and persist it to /etc/profile.d only when necessary, record tool versions and availability in WORKSPACE/.setup_logs. Do NOT write an empty pm placeholder. Fail fast on missing critical runtime or helper utilities used later (sha256sum/sha1sum, setsid, ps, kill, curl/wget). This ensures later steps have the required system utilities and deterministic PATH persistence.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-snake-and-ladder-90776-90804/WebandMobileFrontend"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/webandmobile_frontend.sh
# validate runtimes
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: node not found" > "$LOGDIR/env.err"; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: npm not found" > "$LOGDIR/env.err"; exit 3; }
# detect npm global bin
NPM_GLBIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin")
if [ -d "$NPM_GLBIN" ] && ! echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -xq "$NPM_GLBIN"; then
  sudo bash -c "cat > $PROFILE <<'EOF'
# WebandMobileFrontend: ensure npm global bin on PATH
export PATH=$NPM_GLBIN:\$PATH
EOF"
fi
# helper utilities check
MISSING=0
for cmd in sha256sum sha1sum setsid ps kill curl wget; do
  if ! command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "missing:$cmd" >> "$LOGDIR/env.missing"; MISSING=1; fi
done
if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then echo "ERROR: missing helper utilities (see $LOGDIR/env.missing)" > "$LOGDIR/env.err" && exit 4; fi
# versions and availability summary
node -v > "$LOGDIR/node.version" 2>&1 || true
npm -v > "$LOGDIR/npm.version" 2>&1 || true
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then yarn -v > "$LOGDIR/yarn.version" 2>&1 || true; fi
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then create-react-app --version 2>"$LOGDIR/cra.version" || true; fi
# robust node major parse
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -p "parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0],10)" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then echo "ERROR: node >=16 required, found $(node -v)" > "$LOGDIR/env.err" && exit 5; fi
# summary
printf "PATH=%s\nnode=%s\nnpm=%s\nyarn=%s\n" "$PATH" "$(cat $LOGDIR/node.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" "$(cat $LOGDIR/npm.version 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" "$(cat $LOGDIR/yarn.version 2>/dev/null || echo none)" > "$LOGDIR/env.summary"

steps.name: Install project dependencies with robust idempotency and core deps assurance
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively. Prefer yarn when available; write chosen PM and its version to WORKSPACE/.setup_logs/pm and pm.version. Use sha256sum for checksumming package.json and lockfile (check availability), compute checksum and skip install when unchanged and node_modules exists. For npm choose npm ci only when package-lock.json exists; otherwise use npm install. Ensure core runtime dependencies (react, react-dom, react-scripts) exist in package.json and install missing dev deps independently: '@testing-library/react' and 'serve'. Update checksum after any modifications.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-snake-and-ladder-90776-90804/WebandMobileFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo "package.json missing" > "$LOGDIR/install.err" && exit 2; }
# choose package manager
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM="yarn"; else PM="npm"; fi
echo "$PM" > "$LOGDIR/pm"
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn -v > "$LOGDIR/pm.version" 2>&1 || true; else npm -v > "$LOGDIR/pm.version" 2>&1 || true; fi
# checksum tool
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then SHACMD=sha256sum; elif command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then SHACMD=sha1sum; else echo "ERROR: no checksum tool (sha256sum/sha1sum)" > "$LOGDIR/install.err" && exit 3; fi
# compute checksum of package.json + lockfile (if present)
LOCKFILE=""
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then LOCKFILE="yarn.lock"; elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then LOCKFILE="package-lock.json"; fi
if [ -n "$LOCKFILE" ]; then CHECKSUM=$(cat package.json "$LOCKFILE" | $SHACMD | awk '{print $1}' 2>/dev/null || true); else CHECKSUM=$($SHACMD package.json | awk '{print $1}' 2>/dev/null || true); fi
OLD_CHECKSUM=""
if [ -f "$LOGDIR/dep_checksum" ]; then OLD_CHECKSUM=$(cat "$LOGDIR/dep_checksum" || true); fi
if [ "$CHECKSUM" = "$OLD_CHECKSUM" ] && [ -d node_modules ]; then echo "deps unchanged, skipping install" > "$LOGDIR/install.log"
else
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn install --non-interactive --silent >"$LOGDIR/install.log" 2>"$LOGDIR/install.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/install.err" >&2; exit 4; }
  else
    if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent >"$LOGDIR/install.log" 2>"$LOGDIR/install.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/install.err" >&2; exit 5; }
    else npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent >"$LOGDIR/install.log" 2>"$LOGDIR/install.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/install.err" >&2; exit 6; }
    fi
  fi
  echo "$CHECKSUM" > "$LOGDIR/dep_checksum"
fi
# ensure core runtime deps are present in package.json
MISSING_CORE=0
node -e "try{let p=require('./package.json'); p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{}; const core={'react':'^18.2.0','react-dom':'^18.2.0','react-scripts':'^5.0.1'}; let changed=false; for(const k in core) if(!p.dependencies[k]){p.dependencies[k]=core[k]; changed=true;} if(changed) {require('fs').writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)); process.exit(0);} }catch(e){process.exit(2)}" >/dev/null 2>"$LOGDIR/pkg_update.err" || true
# if package.json was modified ensure install runs again
NEW_CHECKSUM=$($SHACMD package.json | awk '{print $1}' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$NEW_CHECKSUM" ] && [ "$NEW_CHECKSUM" != "$(cat $LOGDIR/dep_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo)" ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn install --non-interactive --silent >>"$LOGDIR/install.log" 2>>"$LOGDIR/install.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/install.err" >&2; exit 7; }
  else npm install --no-audit --no-fund --silent >>"$LOGDIR/install.log" 2>>"$LOGDIR/install.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/install.err" >&2; exit 8; }
  fi
  echo "$NEW_CHECKSUM" > "$LOGDIR/dep_checksum"
fi
# ensure dev deps independently
for pkg in @testing-library/react serve; do
  HAS=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(Boolean((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['$pkg'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['$pkg'])));}catch(e){console.error('pkg_parse_error'); process.exit(2)}" 2>"$LOGDIR/pkg_parse.err" || true)
  if [ "$HAS" != "true" ]; then
    if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn add -D "$pkg" --silent >>"$LOGDIR/devdeps.log" 2>>"$LOGDIR/devdeps.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/devdeps.err" >&2; exit 9; }
    else npm i -D "$pkg" --no-audit --no-fund --silent >>"$LOGDIR/devdeps.log" 2>>"$LOGDIR/devdeps.err" || { cat "$LOGDIR/devdeps.err" >&2; exit 10; }
    fi
  fi
done
# update final checksum
if [ -n "$LOCKFILE" ]; then FINAL_CHK=$(cat package.json "$LOCKFILE" | $SHACMD | awk '{print $1}' 2>/dev/null || true); else FINAL_CHK=$($SHACMD package.json | awk '{print $1}' 2>/dev/null || true); fi
echo "$FINAL_CHK" > "$LOGDIR/dep_checksum"
# record node/npm/yarn versions
node -v > "$LOGDIR/node.version" 2>&1 || true
npm -v > "$LOGDIR/npm.version" 2>&1 || true
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then yarn -v >> "$LOGDIR/pm.version" 2>&1 || true; fi

steps.description: Build the production bundle via the recorded package manager, ensure 'serve' is available locally (install if missing), serve the build from node_modules/.bin/serve under setsid, probe localhost:3000 until responsive or timeout, capture logs and HTTP status to WORKSPACE/validation_evidence.txt, then terminate the process group cleanly. Use npx fallback only if ALLOW_NETWORK_FETCH=1. This provides deterministic evidence that the dev environment can build and serve the app.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-snake-and-ladder-90776-90804/WebandMobileFrontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOGDIR="$WORKSPACE/.setup_logs"; mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
EVIDENCE="$WORKSPACE/validation_evidence.txt"
PM="npm"
[ -f "$LOGDIR/pm" ] && PM=$(cat "$LOGDIR/pm" || echo npm)
# ensure serve present locally
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn add -D serve --silent >"$LOGDIR/serve.install.log" 2>"$LOGDIR/serve.install.err" || true
  else npm i -D serve --no-audit --no-fund --silent >"$LOGDIR/serve.install.log" 2>"$LOGDIR/serve.install.err" || true
  fi
fi
# build
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn build >"$LOGDIR/build.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOGDIR/build.log" >&2; echo "build_failed" > "$EVIDENCE"; exit 10; }
else npm run build >"$LOGDIR/build.log" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOGDIR/build.log" >&2; echo "build_failed" > "$EVIDENCE"; exit 11; }
fi
# choose serve command
SERVE_BIN=""
if [ -f "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve" ]; then SERVE_BIN="$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/serve"; fi
if [ -z "$SERVE_BIN" ]; then
  if [ "${ALLOW_NETWORK_FETCH:-0}" = "1" ]; then SERVE_CMD="npx --yes serve -s build -l 3000"; else echo "serve not installed and network fetch disabled" > "$LOGDIR/serve.err" && echo "serve_missing" > "$EVIDENCE" && exit 12; fi
else
  SERVE_CMD="$SERVE_BIN -s build -l 3000"
fi
# start server under setsid to create PGID and capture logs
LOGFILE="$LOGDIR/serve.log"
setsid bash -lc "$SERVE_CMD" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ' || true)
# probe server
TIMEOUT=30
SLEEP=1
ELAPSED=0
HTTP=000
while [ $ELAPSED -lt $TIMEOUT ]; do
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then HTTP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:3000/ || echo 000)
  elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then HTTP=$(wget -qS --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/ 2>&1 | awk '/HTTP\/{print $2; exit}' || echo 000)
  else HTTP=000; fi
  if [ "$HTTP" != "000" ]; then break; fi
  sleep $SLEEP; ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED+SLEEP));
done
printf "http_status=%s\nstart_pid=%s\nlog=%s\n" "$HTTP" "$PID" "$LOGFILE" > "$EVIDENCE"
head -n 200 "$LOGFILE" > "$LOGDIR/serve_head.log" 2>/dev/null || true
# stop server: kill entire process group
if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -- -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
sleep 1
if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
cat "$EVIDENCE" || true
